ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Bina Kishore Chhabria, a promoter of Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited (ABDL), divested 5.5 million equity shares, representing 1.97% of the company's total paid-up capital, through an open market sale on September 23, 2026. This transaction reduced her individual holding from 58.20% to 56.23% and the overall promoter group's stake from 80.91% to 78.94%. While promoter selling is noteworthy, the promoter group retains a very significant majority ownership, indicating continued strong control and no immediate red flags regarding company stability or strategic direction.
